create_class_inheriting_nicerepr: create a class that inherits from NiceRepr and defines __nice__ to return a custom summary string
use_nicerepr_with_len: create a class inheriting NiceRepr that defines __len__ so __nice__ defaults to returning the object length
test_nicerepr_str_repr: test that a NiceRepr subclass produces formatted __str__ and __repr__ output using the __nice__ method
review_nicerepr_mixin: review the NiceRepr mixin class to understand how __str__ and __repr__ delegate to the __nice__ method
refactor_class_to_use_nicerepr: refactor an existing class to inherit from NiceRepr and implement __nice__ instead of separate __str__ and __repr__
